translation.name: Buki Pilabumaboma Kabutubogwa Deli Kabutuvau
translation.englishName: Kilivila: Buki Pilabumaboma Kabutubogwa Deli Kabutuvau Bible

content: Komwaidona mina Isireli isilavaisi viloupakala Sini isipeipelasi ilosi ambaisa ambaisa, makawala la karaiwaga Guyau. E ibudaisi si kabosikaiwa Repidim, taga kwaitala vavagi, gala sopi baisa paila bimomsi.
Mina Isireli ikavilavilasi baisa Mosese kawasi, “Kusakaimasi sopi bakamomsi.” Mosese ivitakauloki, kawala, “Avaka paila kukwavilavilasi? Avaka paila kudokaisi bukuwakolaisi Guyau?”

Taga tomota saina wala kasi daka, e tuvaila wala isetuwoli si kavilavila baisa Mosese kawasi, “Avaka uula lokumaiyaimasi metoya Itipita? Ki, nanom mwada daka wala bikimataimasi deli litumaiasi deli ma bulutuvalusi?”
Mosese inigada peula baisa Guyau ikaibiga kawala, “Avaka ibodi bavagi paila matausina tomota? Bogwa katitaikina biwaigusi odakuna.”
Guyau iluki Mosese kawala, “Kuvakouli mimilisi mina Isireli kasi tokugwa deli yoku, e bukukugwasi tomota omitasi. Kukwau kaitukwa deli, makaina lokuwaiya Waya Naili.

E yeigu batobogwa odabala kwaitala dakuna wa Koya Sinai. E ka! - bukuwaiya dakuna metoya om kwaitukwa e sopi bisunapula paila tomota bimomsi.” Mosese bogwa ivagi makawala omitasi kasi tokugwa mina Isireli.
E makatupona valu idokaisi yagala Masai deli Meriba.
Paila baisa mina Isireli si kavilavila, deli eiwakolaisi Guyau tuta matutona eikatupoisi kawasi, “Kaina Guyau deli yakidasi kaina gala?”
Tuta makwaina mina Amaleki leimaisi ikabiliasi deli mina Isireli mapilana Repidim.

E Mosese iluki Yosuwa kawala, “Mwa! Kunagi mimilisi tomota e nabwaia kulokaiasi mina Amaleki e deli bukukwabiliasi. Yeigu batotu odabala makwaina koya e baiyosi kaitukwa makaina avaka Yaubada eilukwaigu bakau.”
Yosuwa ivagi makawala avaka Mosese eiluki, e isunapulasi bikabiliasi deli mina Amaleki. E Mosese, Eroni deli Ura ilokaiasi koya makwaina odabala.
E avai tuta Mosese yamala biyosali walakaiwa, e mina Isireli bipeulasi. Mitaga avai tuta yamala bisaili watanawa, e mina Amaleki bipeulasi.

E mapaila tuta matutona Mosese yamala bogwa eitubega, Eroni sola Ura imaiyaisi dakuna paila matauna bisila. E itolisi okanivala e iyosalaisi yamala Mosese, e matausina iyosisi wala tatoula kalasia eisalili.
E makawala goli Yosuwa itomgwaga ikalisau odubasi mina Amaleki.
E Guyau iluki Mosese, kawala, “Kugini bila wa buki ammakawala lokutomgwagasi paila kabilia makwaina, e baisa bivigaki kala kaboluluwai. E kuluki Yosuwa kidamwa bogwa babutugigai mina Amaleki.”
E Mosese ikaliai kwaitala kabolula e idoki yagala “Guyau Matauna ulo Doya.”
E ikaibiga kawala, “Kuyosalaisi la doya Guyau! Guyau bisaitaula bikabilia deli mina Amaleki, tuta gala biwokuva.”

footnotes.text: Masai kala katumiki “wakola”, e Meriba kala katumiki “kavilavila”.
